description: This file is a JavaScript module for integrating Google Calendar with FullCalendar, defining the GcalEventSource class and related functions.

classes.name: GcalEventSource
classes.description: A class extending EventSource to fetch and parse events from Google Calendar API.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses raw input into a GcalEventSource instance if valid.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches events from Google Calendar API within a date range.

methods.name: gcalItemsToRawEventDefs
methods.description: Converts Google Calendar API items to raw event definitions.

methods.name: gcalItemToRawEventDef
methods.description: Converts a single Google Calendar API item to a raw event definition.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs the API URL for Google Calendar.

methods.name: buildRequestParams
methods.description: Builds request parameters for the API call based on date range and timezone.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Handles error reporting for API failures.

methods.name: applyManualStandardProps
methods.description: Applies standard properties from raw input to the instance.

methods.name: applyMiscProps
methods.description: Applies miscellaneous properties to the instance.
